title: SAUSS: Stochastic Approximation with Unbiased Simulated Scores for Limited Dependent Variable Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.25304v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multinomial choice models allow flexible substitution patterns but become computationally demanding with many alternatives or observations. With a fixed per-observation simulation budget, simulated maximum likelihood introduces simulation bias, while each optimization step requires a full-sample likelihood evaluation. We propose Stochastic Approximation with Unbiased Simulated Scores (SAUSS), an averaged stochastic approximation based on conditionally unbiased mini-batch score estimates. Each iteration uses a fixed mini-batch regardless of sample size. For multinomial probit, accept-reject sampling provides exact conditional draws and unbiased score estimates for any fixed number of accepted draws. Under local conditions, asymptotic theory for the averaged estimator and the partial-sum process of the SAUSS iterates incorporates mini-batch and simulation variability and supports random-scaling and plug-in inference. translated_title: SAUSS：基于无偏模拟分数的随机逼近方法用于受限因变量模型
translated_abstract: 多类别选择模型允许灵活替代模式，但在处理大量备选项或观测数据时计算成本高昂。在固定的每观测模拟预算下，模拟最大似然法会引入模拟偏差，而每次优化步骤都需要全样本似然评估。我们提出了基于无偏模拟分数的随机逼近方法（SAUSS），这是一种基于条件无偏小批量分数估计的均值随机逼近方法。每次迭代使用固定的小批量，与样本大小无关。对于多项概率单位模型，接受-拒绝抽样提供精确的条件抽取，并对任意固定数量的接受抽取给出无偏分数估计。在局部条件下，均值估计量的渐近理论和SAUSS迭代的部分和过程纳入了小批量与模拟变异性，并支持随机缩放和插入式推断。在模拟实验和一项...
tldr: 提出了一种基于无偏模拟分数的随机逼近方法（SAUSS），通过固定小批量和无偏分数估计，显著降低多项选择模型的计算成本并消除模拟偏差。
en_tdlr: SAUSS proposes a stochastic approximation method with unbiased simulated scores, using fixed mini-batches to reduce computational cost and eliminate simulation bias in multinomial choice models.
